title: SAM
hero_prompt: Hand-cut paper gouache in the Matisse découpage idiom, a wide banner. A woman's hands cut bold flat-colored paper shapes free from a larger sheet — a bottle, a leaf, a bird — each freed shape lifting just clear of the page it came from, while at one edge a tangle of thin uncut ink scribbles resists the scissors entirely. Hand-made Matisse-style cut-paper gouache (découpage), with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: Bold flat-color silhouette icon in the same cut-paper idiom: a pair of scissors mid-cut through one solid colored shape, two-tone high contrast, no fine linework, reads clean at small size.
